question: When did the Queen Victoria Proclamation declare that India would be governed by and in the name of the British Monarch through a Secretary of State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**01 November 1858**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Queen Victoria Proclamation** was declared on November 1,** 1858,** by **Governor General Lord Canning**.
 
• The **Act abolished the East India Company** and **all the powers of the government, revenues, and territories of India were transferred to the British Crown**.
 
• It also ended the **Doctrine of Lapse**.
 
• The Governor General of India was given the designation of Viceroy of India.
 
• The first Viceroy of India was **Lord Canning**.
 
• The GOI of 1858 set up the office of **Secretary of State for India, and its first secretary was Lord Stanley**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Queen Victoria,** daughter of **Prince Edward,** was **Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland until January** 22, 1901.
 
• **Queen Victoria** was the **great-great-grandmother** of **Queen Elizabeth II**.
